source: Live Advanced Settings hover descriptions and slider endpoint probes in Splitgate 3.1-643074

NeutralizationRate.label: Neutralization Rate
NeutralizationRate.description: How fast the zone should neutralize while empty. 1.f represents standard capture rate

TimeToCapture.label: Time to Capture
TimeToCapture.description: Time to fully capture a point. 0 results in instant captures.

PointsOnCapture.label: Points on Capture
PointsOnCapture.description: The score to give when a capture point is fully captured.

TimeToGroupCapture.label: Time to Group Capture
TimeToGroupCapture.description: Time to score a group capture when all active points in the group are controlled (e.g. Hotzone). 0 means that full group captures will happen the moment all active points are captured.

GroupCapturePoints.label: Group Capture Points
GroupCapturePoints.description: The score to give when all capture points of this type are fully captured by a team.

TimeAddedOnGroupCapture.label: Time Added on Group Capture
TimeAddedOnGroupCapture.description: Game time to add when a group capture occurs.

TickPoints.label: Tick Points
TickPoints.description: The score to give while a point is captured each tick.

bNeutralWhileEmpty.label: Neutral While Empty
bNeutralWhileEmpty.description: Whether or not the zone should neutralize while empty (e.g. KOTH).

bUseTeamOwnership.label: Use Team Ownership
bUseTeamOwnership.description: Whether or not hills should be initialized to their associated teams

bUseAsymmetricObjectives.label: Use Asymmetric Objectives
bUseAsymmetricObjectives.description: If true, only objectives marked for use in asymmetric modes will be enabled.

bRespawnCapturingTeamOnPointCapture.label: Respawn Capturing Team on Point Capture
bRespawnCapturingTeamOnPointCapture.description: If true, players who capture a point will be immediately respawned.

bRespawnOtherTeamsOnPointCapture.label: Respawn Other Teams on Point Capture
bRespawnOtherTeamsOnPointCapture.description: If true, when a point is captured, players who are not on the capturing team will be immediately respawned.

bRespawnCapturingTeamOnGroupCapture.label: Respawn Capturing Team on Group Capture
bRespawnCapturingTeamOnGroupCapture.description: If true, players who complete a full capture will be immediately respawned.

bRespawnOtherTeamsOnGroupCapture.label: Respawn Other Teams on Group Capture
bRespawnOtherTeamsOnGroupCapture.description: If true, when a group capture occurs, players who are not on the capturing team will be immediately respawned.

bRandomizeCapturePointGroups.label: Randomize Capture Point Groups
bRandomizeCapturePointGroups.description: If true, randomizes objective group order.

bRandomizeCapturePoints.label: Randomize Capture Points
bRandomizeCapturePoints.description: If true, randomizes capture point order within groups.

MaxPointsToActivate.label: Max Points to Activate
MaxPointsToActivate.description: Maximum number of points to activate at any moment within a group. If 0, all points in a group will be activated.

TimeBeforeDeactivation.label: Time Before Deactivation
TimeBeforeDeactivation.description: Amount of time for points to deactivate after activation. If 0, the objective will not deactivate automatically after a timer.

BombDefuseTime.label: Bomb Defuse Time
BombDefuseTime.description: The time it takes to defuse a bomb that has been planted. If this time is <= 0 then the bomb will be defused instantly.
BombDefuseTime.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

BombExplodeTime.label: Bomb Explode Time
BombExplodeTime.description: The time it takes for a bomb to explode after it has been planted. If this time is <= 0 then the bomb will explode instantly.
BombExplodeTime.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

BombPlantTime.label: Bomb Plant Time
BombPlantTime.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI
BombPlantTime.descriptionStatus: Hover title visible but description empty; recheck in another Firecracker preset.

BombReturnTime.label: Bomb Return Time
BombReturnTime.description: The time it takes for a bomb to return when it has been dropped without being planted. If this time is == 0 then the bomb will be returned instantly when dropped. If this time is < 0 then the bomb will never automatically return.
BombReturnTime.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

DefuseScore.label: Defuse Score
DefuseScore.description: The score to give the team that defused a bomb.
DefuseScore.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bAllowManualBombReturn.label: Allow Manual Bomb Return
bAllowManualBombReturn.description: If true, the attacking team can trigger the bomb to return by interacting with the bomb spawner. This only works when the bomb is dropped - it cannot be triggered while the bomb is being carried or if it has been planted.
bAllowManualBombReturn.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bBombAwayTriggersSuddenDeath.label: Bomb Away Triggers Sudden Death
bBombAwayTriggersSuddenDeath.description: If true, sudden death activates at the end of the round if the bomb is anywhere BUT the bomb spawner. If this is False, sudden death will still be active while the bomb is planted or while it is being planted.
bBombAwayTriggersSuddenDeath.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bPreventDefenderRespawnsOnPlant.label: Prevent Defender Respawns on Plant
bPreventDefenderRespawnsOnPlant.description: If true, players defending a plant zone will not be able to respawn as long as a bomb has been planted at one of their zones. Neutral plant zones do not affect this.
bPreventDefenderRespawnsOnPlant.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bPreventAttackerRespawnsOnPlant.label: Prevent Attacker Respawns on Plant
bPreventAttackerRespawnsOnPlant.description: If true, players who planted a bomb (and their team) will not be able to respawn as long as the bomb stays planted. This only affects a single team, not any other teams that may be present. As such, this only really makes sense to use in 2-team scenarios.
bPreventAttackerRespawnsOnPlant.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnDefendersOnPlant.label: Respawn Defenders on Plant
bRespawnDefendersOnPlant.description: If true, players defending a plant zone will be immediately respawned once a bomb has been planted at one of their zones. Neutral plant zones do not affect this.
bRespawnDefendersOnPlant.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnAttackersOnPlant.label: Respawn Attackers on Plant
bRespawnAttackersOnPlant.description: If true, players who planted a bomb (and their team) will be immediately respawned once the bomb is planted. This only affects a single team, not any other teams that may be present. As such, this only really makes sense to use in 2-team scenarios.
bRespawnAttackersOnPlant.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnDefendersOnDefuse.label: Respawn Defenders on Defuse
bRespawnDefendersOnDefuse.description: If true, players defending a plant zone will be immediately respawned once a bomb is defused at one of their zones. Neutral plant zones do not affect this.
bRespawnDefendersOnDefuse.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnAttackersOnDefuse.label: Respawn Attackers on Defuse
bRespawnAttackersOnDefuse.description: If true, players who planted a bomb (and their team) will be immediately respawned once the bomb is defused. This only affects a single team, not any other teams that may be present. As such, this only really makes sense to use in 2-team scenarios.
bRespawnAttackersOnDefuse.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

ExplodeScore.label: Explode Score
ExplodeScore.description: The score to give the team that planted a bomb that exploded.
ExplodeScore.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

ObjectiveType.label: Objective Type
ObjectiveType.description: Whether or not the mode is team (i.e. offense/defense) assault or neutral assault
ObjectiveType.source: Live Chaos Firecracker Standard Rules / Mode UI

bEnableCaptureZones.label: Enable Capture Zones
bEnableCaptureZones.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

InitialObjectives.label: Initial Objectives
InitialObjectives.description: The number of initial objectives to spawn. Set to <= 0 to disable initial objectives.
InitialObjectives.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

InitialObjectiveTime.label: Initial Objective Time
InitialObjectiveTime.description: The amount of time before spawning the initial set of objectives. Set to <= 0 to spawn immediately.
InitialObjectiveTime.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

AdditionalObjectives.label: Additional Objectives
AdditionalObjectives.description: The number of objectives to spawn every time the additional objective timer expires. Set to <= 0 to disable additional objectives.
AdditionalObjectives.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

AdditionalObjectiveTime.label: Additional Objective Time
AdditionalObjectiveTime.description: The amount of time after the initial spawn before new objectives spawn. This timer loops. Set to <= 0 to disable additional objectives.
AdditionalObjectiveTime.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

MaxObjectives.label: Max Objectives
MaxObjectives.description: The maximum number of objectives that can be spawned. Set to <= 0 for no maximum.
MaxObjectives.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

ReturnTime.label: Return Time
ReturnTime.description: The amount of time before an objective is returned after being dropped when "not" in a capture zone. Set to 0 for instant returns.
ReturnTime.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

ReturnTimeMultiplierWhenOutOfBounds.label: Return Time Multiplier when Out Of Bounds
ReturnTimeMultiplierWhenOutOfBounds.description: The applied multiplier to the ReturnTime timer when an objective is out of bounds.
ReturnTimeMultiplierWhenOutOfBounds.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRandomizeInitialSpawns.label: Randomize Initial Spawns
bRandomizeInitialSpawns.description: If true, initial objective spawns will be selected in a random order. If false, initial objective spawns will be selected in order of spawn index (lowest to highest).
bRandomizeInitialSpawns.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRandomizeAdditionalSpawns.label: Randomize Additional Spawns
bRandomizeAdditionalSpawns.description: If true, additional objective spawns will be selected in a random order. If false, additional objective spawns will be selected in order of spawn index (lowest to highest).
bRandomizeAdditionalSpawns.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

bScoreBallsOutsideZone.label: Score Balls Outside Zone
bScoreBallsOutsideZone.description: If true, objectives will count for their capture zone's team even when not inside that zone. This is also known as "paintball" mode as balls conceptually are "painted" by their capture zone until captured by a different one. This means that objectives will not return to "neutral" when removed from a capture zone.
bScoreBallsOutsideZone.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnPlayersOnObjectiveSpawn.label: Respawn Players on Objective Spawn
bRespawnPlayersOnObjectiveSpawn.description: If true, all players will be respawned when a new objective spawns.
bRespawnPlayersOnObjectiveSpawn.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRespawnPlayersOnFirstObjectiveCapture.label: Respawn Players on First Objective Capture
bRespawnPlayersOnFirstObjectiveCapture.description: If true, all players will be respawned the first time each unique objective is captured.
bRespawnPlayersOnFirstObjectiveCapture.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

ObjectiveScore.label: Objective Score
ObjectiveScore.description: The amount of score each objective in a capture zone is worth.
ObjectiveScore.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

HeldBallScore.label: Held Ball Score
HeldBallScore.description: The amount of score each objective being held is worth.
HeldBallScore.source: Live Chaos Splitball Standard Rules / Mode UI

KitKillKillerScore.label: Kit Kill Killer Score
KitKillKillerScore.description: The score to give players on a standard kill with a weapon in their kit.
KitKillKillerScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

KitKillVictimScore.label: Kit Kill Victim Score
KitKillVictimScore.description: The score to give players on a standard kill with a weapon in their kit.
KitKillVictimScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

HumiliationKillKillerScore.label: Humiliation Kill Killer Score
HumiliationKillKillerScore.description: The score to give killers on a "humiliation" kill (kills with items like melee and so on when gun kills are intended).
HumiliationKillKillerScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

HumiliationKillVictimScore.label: Humiliation Kill Victim Score
HumiliationKillVictimScore.description: The score to give victims who die to a "humiliation" kill (kills with items like melee and so on when gun kills are intended).
HumiliationKillVictimScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

AssistedSuicideKillerScore.label: Assisted Suicide Killer Score
AssistedSuicideKillerScore.description: The score to give killers on an "assisted suicide" kill (suicides where the victim takes damage from an outside source before the suicide).
AssistedSuicideKillerScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

AssistedSuicideVictimScore.label: Assisted Suicide Victim Score
AssistedSuicideVictimScore.description: The score to give victims who die to an "assisted suicide" kill (suicides where the victim takes damage from an outside source before the suicide).
AssistedSuicideVictimScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

SelfSuicideScore.label: Self Suicide Score
SelfSuicideScore.description: The score to give to players who suicide without outside interference (i.e. suicides that aren't assisted by hostile players).
SelfSuicideScore.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

bWinOnFinalKitPromotion.label: Win on Final Kit Promotion
bWinOnFinalKitPromotion.description: Whether promoting past the final kit should grant a win to all players matching the condition
bWinOnFinalKitPromotion.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

bUpdateLoadoutWhileAlive.label: Update Loadout While Alive
bUpdateLoadoutWhileAlive.description: Whether we should update players' loadouts while they're still alive
bUpdateLoadoutWhileAlive.source: Live Gun Game Standard Rules / Mode UI

bRaceRestartsEnabled.label: Race Restarts Enabled
bRaceRestartsEnabled.description: Whether or not restarting the race is allowed.
bRaceRestartsEnabled.source: Live Race Standard Rules / Mode hover

TeabagConfirmPoints.label: Teabag Confirm Points
TeabagConfirmPoints.description: How many points are earned upon confirming an opposing teabag.
TeabagConfirmPoints.notes: Both large negative and positive numeric entries and slider drag clamp/display 0 in game; original saved confirm value is 1. Preserve saved defaults; UI endpoints are 0/0, not engine limits.

TeabagDenyPoints.label: Teabag Deny Points
TeabagDenyPoints.description: How many points are earned upon confirming a friendly teabag.
TeabagDenyPoints.notes: Both large negative and positive numeric entries and slider drag clamp/display 0 in game; original saved confirm value is 1. Preserve saved defaults; UI endpoints are 0/0, not engine limits.
